title: Foster v. Colorado Radio — bifurcation
summary: The note describes separating goods and nongoods aspects of the sale of a radio station.
notes:
Casebook discussion of a shorter authority.

This approach differs from classifying the whole contract by its predominant purpose. It is a competing method reported in the casebook, not a direction to use bifurcation in every jurisdiction.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 249. Open assigned page 249.
